newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac has no doubt Spain to join EMU in 1999.
newsitem.headline: Chirac has no doubt Spain to join EMU in 1999.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Tuesday he has no doubt that Spain would be among the first countries to join a single European currency in 1999.
"I have no doubts as far as Spain is concerned," Chirac told a news conference after talks with Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar at a Franco-Spanish summit.
Both leaders had been asked about the prospects of Spain joining European monetary union at the earliest possible date in 1999.
They had also been asked whether they felt Spain could join a single currency without Italy.
Continuing the same response, Chirac said that "Italy has shown the same desire" to join a single currency at the outset and that he welcomed this.
